Class GateKeeper

java.lang.Object
org.apache.maven.AbstractMavenLifecycleParticipant
network.ike.tooling.buildreport.GateKeeper
@Named("ike-build-report-gate") @Singleton public class GateKeeper extends org.apache.maven.AbstractMavenLifecycleParticipant
Session-end gate enforcement (ike-issues#989).

At afterSessionEnd — after the receipt is on disk, thanks to ReportSession.finalizeAndWrite()'s idempotence — this participant fails the build when the ledger declares mode: gate and gating ATTENTION exists. It never fails a build that already failed, never enforces when the escape hatch property ("ike.build.report.gate.skip") is set, and the skip itself is recorded in the receipt. In mode: report this participant is a spectator.
